entities.name: Professor Willowdusk
entities.description: Ancient dryad instructor at Witherbloom College, considered the oldest dryad on Arcavios.

entities.name: Witherbloom College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven University where Willowdusk teaches.

entities.name: Detention Bog
entities.description: Treacherous bog where students became lost.

entities.name: Widdershins Hall
entities.description: Place Willowdusk guided students back to.

entities.name: Bogroffs
entities.description: Ravenous creatures that attacked the students.

entities.name: Blood Age
entities.description: Era Willowdusk claims to have lived since.

events.summary: Lost students shelter among Willowdusk's roots; she protects them from bogroffs and guides them back to Widdershins Hall.
events.quote: She protected them from an attack by ravenous bogroffs

events.summary: Impressed by her guidance, Strixhaven invites Willowdusk to join as a professor.
events.quote: she was invited to join Strixhaven as a professor

relations.quote: serves as an instructor at the Witherbloom College
